body.p: Unoko and Makulu lived at Kumakdju. One time, in summer, they heard something breathing not far from their tents. Their dogs howled, and acted as though they were much afraid. They crawled up on top of the tent. Then the men heard another peculiar noise, as though somebody were carrying a young dog away. On the following morning they saw footprints of Adlet. It looked as though they had worn a piece of skin on the sole of each foot. It is said that the Adlet do not wear boots.
